messages:
anya: Nightly eval alert (run 2026-03-19#452) — multiple suites failed under small-batch settings. Initial severity P2. Failing suites: codegen-longcontext-v2, instruction-coherence, safety-guardrails. Anyone able to triage?
ci-bot: CI Nightly — eval-run 2026-03-19#452 FAILED (3 suites). Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/452 · logs: https://s3.redwood/evals/452/logs · alert id: NE-452
max: On it. We rolled the quant bridge (quant4->int4) + small-batch packing yesterday. My hunch is a KV-cache misalignment when batch packing changes. Pulling runtime logs now.
lina: I saw a similar pattern in a canary earlier when batch-size went 1->8. I can rerun the failing suites with batching disabled on a dedicated node to isolate.
sam: Can we get 1-2 sample failures to eyeball? Dashboard summary shows hallucination spike and truncated tokens for long-code prompts.
anya: Pasting an anonymized sample from the codegen-longcontext-v2 cohort:
```
PROMPT: // reconstruct function after comment
/* returns nth fib */
... (long context)
MODEL: <output starts good then repeats>
output: "function fib(n) { if (n<2) return n; return fib(n-1)+fib(n-2) }"
then: "function fib(n) { function fib(n) { function fib(n) { ..."
LOG: WARN runtime: KV cache mismatch for key shard=3 seq=8192 expected_len=10240 got=8192
```
max: That `KV cache mismatch` is the smoking gun. Looks like when packer merges prefixes we sometimes skip updating per-instance cache offsets. Assigning runtime-owner: max, eval-owner: lina. If rerun still fails -> escalate to P1 and consider rollback.
lina: I'll schedule reruns with `--batching=off --kv-precache=on` on a dedicated 8xA100 slot and compare metrics. Command I will run: `redwood-eval run --suite codegen-longcontext-v2,instruction-coherence,safety-guardrails --model redwood/gpt-bridge-int4 --batch-size 1 --kv-precache yes --tag triage-452`
ci-bot: Rerun scheduled: eval-run 2026-03-19#452-retry-1 (owner: lina) · ETA ~8m. Logs will stream to https://s3.redwood/evals/452/retry-1/logs
anya: Owners confirmed: max (runtime), lina (evals). Notifying infra for dedicated capacity allocation. If retry is green we can mark as regression caused by packer + quant bridge.
sam: Adding ticket INF-3021 (eval regression triage) and linking this thread. If retry fails, propose we pin tonight's jobs to `quant4-compat` model variant as temporary mitigation.
max: I pulled shard logs and opened a quick fix: skip batch packing when any seq_len > 4096 (PR #876). Pushed to staging; will test with lina's rerun. If it looks safe I'll promote.
lina: If the PR is risky for production, I'll instead pin the model in the nightly job to `redwood/gpt-bridge-quant4-compat` and rerun full suite.
anya: :thumbsup: Good plan. Keep this thread updated with rerun pass/fail and decide whether to roll forward or pin. Marking initial severity P2 -> escalate to P1 if rerun fails or more than 30% of cohort affected.
ci-bot: Rerun started (2026-03-19T03:18:40Z) · eval-run 452-retry-1 stream: https://s3.redwood/evals/452/retry-1/stream
max: I'll tail the logs and post diffs here when available.
anya: Thanks — assigning follow-ups: max (runtime bug), lina (rerun + diffs), sam (ticket + rollback plan).
ci-bot: Note: automated alert will re-evaluate severity after retry finishes.
